slides.title: Peace be upon him
slides.transcript: [warmly] Our Prophet. A book for Noah, peace be upon him. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] Eight small things, and all of them easy to copy.

slides.title: And So We Say
slides.transcript: [softly] And So We Say. <break time="0.4s" /> Kind to children, kind to animals, kind to whoever was hungry. When we hear his name, we say one thing. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Peace be upon him. Goodnight, Noah.
